name: Sweet Clockwork
source:
"To save you, I have repeated death thousands of times." In this time-loop mystery romance, you must use your "Time Travel Ring" to uncover the identity of the killer "X" within the endlessly repeating day. Stop the destined tragedy and change your fate.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756930/Sweet_Clockwork/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“为了拯救你，我已经重复死亡数千次。”

在这部时间循环悬疑恋爱作品中，你必须使用“时间旅行戒指”，在不断重复的一天里揭开杀人凶手“X”的身份。阻止注定发生的悲剧，改变自己的命运。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756930/Sweet_Clockwork/]Steam[/url]]
